author: Junr
body:
Hello! We, Team Emoji, are looking for two scrims. 
We have two scrim servers reserved, one on Friday June 17th at 3pm PST, (tomorrow) and one Saturday June 18th at 1pm PST. The team we were originally going to scrim against can't make it to any of those times after all, so we are last minute looking for another team to scrim, Thank You!
